cities.name: Valletta

interests.name: Historic Streets 🎭
interests.description: Valletta’s narrow limestone streets, balconies, and charming alleys create a living open-air museum. Perfect for slow strolls, photographs, and café stops.

interests.name: Fortress Views 🏰
interests.description: The fortified walls and viewpoints like Upper Barrakka offer sweeping panoramas of the Grand Harbour and historic battlements.

interests.name: Harbor Walks 🌊
interests.description: The waterfront area is lined with colorful historic warehouses, cafés, restaurants, and stunning harbor views.

interests.name: Art & Culture 🎨
interests.description: Valletta is rich in museums, churches, and cultural institutions. MUŻA and St. John’s Co-Cathedral highlight Malta’s artistic heritage.

interests.name: Local Food Exploration 😋
interests.description: Mediterranean dishes, ftira bread, pastries, soups, and seafood reflect the island’s warm coastal cuisine.

cities.local_food_tip: Maltese pies, vegetable soups, ftira bread, pastries and Mediterranean salads — jednostavno i preukusno.
cities.full_day: Morning: Start at Upper Barrakka Gardens for Grand Harbour views → walk historic streets → coffee along Republic Street. Afternoon: See the exterior of St. John’s Co-Cathedral → lunch with ftira, salads, soups → explore MUŻA museum → stroll the Valletta Waterfront. Sunset: Enjoy golden harbor light at the Siege Bell Memorial. Night: Dinner and dessert along the waterfront.

places.name: Upper Barrakka Gardens
places.description: One of Valletta’s most iconic viewpoints, overlooking the Grand Harbour and the Three Cities.

places.name: St. John’s Co-Cathedral
places.description: A masterpiece of baroque art with an ornate interior and deep cultural history.

places.name: Republic Street
places.description: Valletta’s main pedestrian street, lined with shops, cafés, and historic buildings.

places.name: Valletta Waterfront
places.description: A picturesque promenade with bars, restaurants, and colorful historic architecture.

places.name: MUŻA – National Museum of Art
places.description: Malta’s national art museum featuring classical and modern Maltese artworks.

places.name: Siege Bell War Memorial
places.description: Overlooks the Grand Harbour with stunning sunset views.

hidden_gems.name: Lower Barrakka Gardens
hidden_gems.description: A quieter garden space with excellent views of the harbor and historic monuments.

hidden_gems.name: St. Barbara Bastion
hidden_gems.description: One of Valletta’s most beautiful residential bastions with peaceful sea views.

hidden_gems.name: Chapel of St. Roque Corner Viewpoint
hidden_gems.description: A tiny corner of Valletta offering hidden panoramic spots over the harbor.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Malta buses connect all major towns.
⛴️ Ferries link Valletta with Sliema & Three Cities.
🚶 Compact and walkable city center.
📱 Use the Tallinja app for routes & tickets.

cities.name: Birgu (Vittoriosa)

interests.name: Harbor Walks 🌊
interests.description: The peaceful Vittoriosa Waterfront offers marina views, boats, cafés and a calm atmosphere along the Grand Harbour.

interests.name: Fortress History 🏰
interests.description: Fort St. Angelo is one of Malta’s most important historical fortresses, standing proudly over the harbour.

interests.name: Old Streets 🎭
interests.description: Birgu has some of the oldest and most atmospheric streets in Malta — narrow alleys, stone houses, and quiet corners.

cities.local_food_tip: Mediterranean soups, salads, ftira and pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Walk the marina promenade → see Fort St. Angelo (Exterior) → coffee by the waterfront. Afternoon: Explore narrow old streets → light veggie lunch → stroll historic docks. Sunset: Harbour glowing at golden hour. Night: Quiet waterfront lights and relaxed evening walk.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Bus lines from Valletta go directly to Birgu.
⛴️ Ferry connects Valletta ↔ Birgu in minutes.
🚶 Birgu is compact and walkable.

cities.name: Mdina

interests.name: Historic Streets 🎭
interests.description: Mdina’s narrow alleys, limestone walls and quiet corners create a unique ‘Silent City’ atmosphere unlike anywhere else in Malta.

interests.name: Old Walls 🏰
interests.description: The fortified walls and Mdina Gate offer postcard-perfect medieval views and access to the historic core of the city.

interests.name: Hilltop Views 🌅
interests.description: From Bastion Square, visitors get sweeping panoramas over central Malta — especially stunning during sunset.

cities.local_food_tip: Pastries, soups, salads and light Mediterranean meals.
cities.full_day: Morning: Enter through Mdina Gate → wander the historic Silent City streets → coffee with views at Bastion Square. Afternoon: Explore exterior palaces such as Palazzo Falson → lunch with Mediterranean dishes → stroll viewpoints along the city walls. Sunset: Golden light sweeping across Malta from Bastion Square. Night: Walk through Mdina’s lantern-lit alleys — the true ‘Silent City’ glow.

places.name: Mdina Gate
places.description: The iconic entrance to Mdina, featured in countless films and one of Malta’s most famous landmarks.

places.name: Mdina Old City
places.description: A fully preserved medieval town of narrow alleys, palaces and silent walkways — the ‘Silent City’.

places.name: Bastion Square Viewpoint
places.description: One of the best viewpoints in Malta with sweeping views over the island.

places.name: Palazzo Falson
places.description: A beautiful medieval palace offering a glimpse into Malta’s noble history (exterior for this itinerary).

hidden_gems.name: Mdina Ditch Gardens
hidden_gems.description: Beautiful landscaped gardens outside the city walls — peaceful and great for photos.

hidden_gems.name: St. Agatha’s Chapel Courtyard
hidden_gems.description: A quiet little courtyard tucked away near the city entrance — serene and less visited.

hidden_gems.name: Silent City Alley Corners
hidden_gems.description: Unmarked but atmospheric alleyways perfect for photography and calm wandering.

ideas: 🌸 Bloomy corners around Mdina Ditch Gardens
🚶 Cool walks through Silent City alleys
🌞 Light stone alleys glowing in sunlight
🌇 Sunset views from the city walls
🍁 Warm sandstone tones in Old City streets
🥧 Cozy cafés in the historic center

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Direct buses run between Valletta and Mdina.
🚶 The entire walled city is fully walkable.
📱 Use the Tallinja app for bus routes and tickets.

city_events.name: Medieval Mdina Festival
city_events.description: 🏰 Costumes, crafts and reenactments throughout the Silent City.

cities.name: Mellieħa

interests.name: Beaches 🌊
interests.description: Mellieħa Bay (Għadira Bay) is Malta’s largest sandy beach — long, shallow, perfect for walks, swimming, and relaxing coastal mornings.

interests.name: Nature Walks 🌿
interests.description: Għadira Nature Reserve and the nearby countryside paths offer peaceful walks with dunes, protected wildlife, and wide open views.

interests.name: Scenic Views 🌅
interests.description: High viewpoints above Mellieħa provide sunsets over the bay and sweeping views toward Gozo and Comino.

cities.local_food_tip: Salads, soups, ftira, Mediterranean bowls and pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Enjoy soft sand and blue water at Mellieħa Bay → relax at a beach café. Afternoon: Walk the trails around Għadira Nature Reserve → lunch with Mediterranean dishes → explore the historic Mellieħa town center. Sunset: Watch golden colors from Mellieħa Panorama Viewpoint. Night: Seaside lights along the bay promenade.

places.name: Mellieħa Bay (Għadira Bay)
places.description: Malta’s most famous sandy beach — wide, calm waters and great for long walks and swimming.

places.name: Għadira Nature Reserve
places.description: A peaceful protected area with unique wildlife, shallow lagoons, and quiet pathways.

places.name: Mellieħa Parish Church Viewpoint
places.description: A beautiful hilltop church overlooking the entire bay — a great photography and viewing spot.

places.name: Mellieħa Panorama Viewpoint
places.description: One of the best sunset viewpoints in the area, with sweeping coastal scenery.

hidden_gems.name: Popeye Village Viewpoint
hidden_gems.description: A quirky film-set village with a spectacular cliffside viewpoint — great for photos even without entering.

hidden_gems.name: Għadira Dunes Walk
hidden_gems.description: Small but beautiful natural dunes just behind the bay — peaceful and often overlooked.

hidden_gems.name: Mellieħa Quiet Lanes
hidden_gems.description: Calm backstreets with traditional Maltese balconies and quiet hilltop corners.

ideas: ☕ Terraces in the sunny town center
🌞 Mild coastal weather perfect for walks

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Mellieħa is a major bus hub for northern Malta.
🚶 The coastline and town center are walkable.
📱 Use the Tallinja app for bus timetables and tickets.

cities.name: Rabat

interests.name: Historic Streets 🎭
interests.description: Traditional Maltese limestone streets, balconies, quiet alleys and historic atmosphere surrounding the city near Mdina.

interests.name: Parks 🌿
interests.description: Howard Gardens, at the edge of Rabat, offer peaceful greenery, shade, flowers and relaxing walking paths.

interests.name: Calm Culture 🚶
interests.description: Rabat is known for its quiet cultural spots, churches and catacombs that reflect centuries of local history.

cities.full_day: Morning: Explore the historic alleys of Rabat → enjoy a warm drink at a local café. Afternoon: Walk through Howard Gardens and the Saqqajja surroundings → light Mediterranean lunch → visit exterior cultural spots like St. Paul's Catacombs. Sunset: Enjoy soft golden light from the hill near Mdina Gate. Night: Quiet old-town streets with warm evening lights.

places.name: Rabat Old Streets
places.description: Beautiful limestone alleys, balconies and traditional Maltese architecture.

places.name: Howard Gardens
places.description: A peaceful green area between Rabat and Mdina — perfect for relaxing walks.

places.name: St. Paul's Catacombs (Exterior)
places.description: Historical underground cemetery complex; viewing the grounds and exteriors gives cultural insight.

places.name: Saqqajja Hill Area
places.description: A lively part of Rabat with cafés, views and local atmosphere.

hidden_gems.name: Domus Romana (Exterior Garden)
hidden_gems.description: A Roman-era site with quiet exterior gardens and peaceful surroundings.

hidden_gems.name: Nigret Countryside Paths
hidden_gems.description: Quiet rural walking trails just outside Rabat.

hidden_gems.name: St. Mary of Jesus Church Terrace
hidden_gems.description: A peaceful corner with views of Rabat’s rooftops.

public_transport_tips.tip: 🚌 Direct buses connect Rabat with Valletta and Mdina.
🚶 Almost the entire center is easy to explore on foot.
📱 Use the Tallinja app for real-time bus schedules.

cities.name: Sliema

interests.name: Seaside Walks 🌊
interests.description: Sliema’s long promenade offers coastal paths, clear sea views, and a relaxing Mediterranean atmosphere.

interests.name: Urban Culture 🎭
interests.description: A mix of modern cafés, shopping streets, seaside terraces and lively urban corners.

interests.name: Views of Valletta 🌅
interests.description: Sliema offers some of the best waterfront viewpoints of Valletta’s skyline, especially at sunset.

cities.local_food_tip: Mediterranean bowls, salads, soups and light pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Walk the Sliema Promenade → enjoy a seaside coffee at a local café. Afternoon: Explore urban shopping streets → vegetarian lunch → walk towards Valletta-view spots near the Sliema Ferry. Night: Waterfront promenade with marina reflections + dessert shops.

places.name: Sliema Promenade
places.description: Long coastal walkway perfect for morning or sunset strolls.

places.name: The Plaza Shopping Centre
places.description: Shops, cafés and urban spots in the heart of Sliema.

places.name: Sliema Ferry Terminal
places.description: The best location for Valletta views and quick ferry transport.

hidden_gems.name: Fond Għadir Beach Pools
hidden_gems.description: Rock-cut seaside pools loved by locals — great quiet swimming spots.

hidden_gems.name: Independence Garden
hidden_gems.description: A peaceful park along the promenade with sea views and seating areas.

hidden_gems.name: Sliema Waterfront Steps
hidden_gems.description: Hidden steps and viewpoints overlooking Valletta — great for photography.

public_transport_tips.tip: ⛴️ Take the fast ferry between Sliema and Valletta — runs all day.
🚌 Sliema has excellent Malta bus connections to most towns.
🚶 The coastline is fully walkable and perfect for exploring on foot.
📱 Use the Tallinja app for live bus times and top-ups.
